items.information: # Deuxième Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! L’aventure continue ! Après une première compétition en 2025, nous sommes ravis de vous accueillir pour la **deuxième compétition officielle WCA en Côte d’Ivoire**, qui aura lieu le **samedi 4 juillet** ! Que vous ayez déjà participé à une compétition ou que vous découvriez tout juste le speedcubing, cette compétition est faite pour vous. Plusieurs épreuves officielles seront au programme : **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 à une main**, **Skewb** et **Pyraminx**. Vous pouvez participer à celles que vous souhaitez ! **Première compétition WCA ?** Aucun problème ! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** sera proposé pour vous expliquer le déroulement, les règles et l’arbitrage. Pensez simplement à apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Rejoignez-nous pour continuer à faire grandir la communauté du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire — venez résoudre, concourir et partager ce moment avec nous ! --- # Ivory Coast’s Second Official WCA Competition! The journey continues! After a first competition in 2025, we are excited to welcome you to the **second official WCA competition in Ivory Coast**, taking place on **Saturday, July 4th**! Whether you have already competed before or are just discovering speedcubing, this competition is for you. Several official events will be held: **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 One-Handed**, **Skewb**, and **Pyraminx**. Feel free to compete in any or all of them! **First WCA competition?** No worries! A **newcomer tutorial** will be available to guide you through the competition format, rules, and judging. Just remember to bring a valid **ID** for registration. Come and be part of the growing speedcubing community in Ivory Coast — solve, compete, and enjoy the experience together!

items.information: # Português • A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. • Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. • **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. • **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. • As inscrições custam R$ 25,00 (vinte e cinco reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). • Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 30,00 (trinta reais), caso haja vagas. • # English • Registration is open to any person, from any country. • To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. • **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. • **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. • Registration costs R$25.00 (twenty five Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY5NTg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2b5d6605e32ee67f046565328df55fb836d4c150/CaminosSJI.jpg) ***🎵"Qué bonito amor, Qué bonito cielo, Qué bonita luna, Qué bonito sol..."🎶*** ## Caminos de Guanajuato – San José Iturbide, Guanajuato 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** continúa su recorrido y hace escala en **San José Iturbide, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de *José Alfredo Jiménez* acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a San José Iturbide. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Irapuato para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in San José Iturbide to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/
